stem, sicut nos etiam docet illud dictum Christi paulo

main_text.l: Ex operibus agnoscamus necesse est nos habere ve-
ram fidem, quia effectus non est sine causa sua, & hanc
ex effectu proprio cognoscere oportet. Quando igi-
tur bona opera seu novam obedientiam in nobis non
sentimus, sumus hypocritæ, nec habemus fidem, sed
malam conscientiam. Fides .n. vera ( quæ nunquam
fructibus omnib. suis cat,et[?]) sola, velut arbor quædam
fructifera, profert bona opera, obedientiam,
scientiam[?]: rursus hæc discernunt veram fidem ab hi-
storica, temporali, atque adeo ab ipsa hypocrisi. 2.

l.i: Ut certissimus nobis impetratam per Christum remissionem pec-
catorum, & nos esse propter Christum iustificatos.

page.notes: Page is a single text column with five marginal references in the left margin, all transcribed as notes. The word "cat,et" in the parenthesis after "suis" is printed with a probable misprint and is marked [?]. The word after "obedientiam," (a short word ending in "-tiam") is unclear and marked [?]. The catchword at the lower right is uncertain, read as "cita" with a doubtful final mark. Long s is transcribed as plain s throughout. Printed text ends mid-word ("ex") at the bottom of the column; the continuation appears as the catchword.
